dockerfile
# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend to avoid prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install all necessary build dependencies, compilers, Git, and Open MPI
# Also, fetch, build the application, and place the executable on the system PATH
# A single RUN layer is used to reduce image size by cleaning up in the same step
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Ensure certificates are up to date
    update-ca-certificates && \
    # Create a temporary build directory
    mkdir -p /opt/build && \
    cd /opt/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the AMG repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git . && \
    # Navigate to the test directory which contains the main application Makefile
    cd test && \
    # Build the 'amg' executable
    make amg && \
    # Copy the compiled binary to a system path location
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Ensure the binary is executable
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to reduce final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/build && \
    # Clean up apt cache
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove git make build-essential gfortran libopenmpi-dev && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes
# These settings improve performance and compatibility in non-HPC network environments
RUN echo "btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism = none" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_mapping_policy = slot" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_oversubscribe = 1" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a default working directory
WORKDIR /

# Define the default command to run when the container starts
# This will execute the amg benchmark with a sample problem set
CMD ["mpirun", "amg", "-n", "10", "10", "10"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend to avoid prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install all necessary build dependencies, compilers, Git, and Open MPI
# Also, fetch, build the application, and place the executable on the system PATH
# A single RUN layer is used to reduce image size by cleaning up in the same step
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Ensure certificates are up to date
    update-ca-certificates && \
    # Create a temporary build directory
    mkdir -p /opt/build && \
    cd /opt/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the AMG repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git . && \
    # FIX: Build from the root of the repository to ensure all library dependencies are compiled first.
    # The 'amg' executable is generated in the 'test' subdirectory.
    make && \
    # Copy the compiled binary from its build location to a system path
    cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Ensure the binary is executable
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to reduce final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/build && \
    # Clean up apt cache and unneeded build-time packages
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove git make build-essential gfortran libopenmpi-dev && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes
# These settings improve performance and compatibility in non-HPC network environments
RUN echo "btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism = none" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_mapping_policy = slot" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_oversubscribe = 1" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a default working directory
WORKDIR /

# Define the default command to run when the container starts
# This will execute the amg benchmark with a sample problem set
CMD ["mpirun", "amg", "-n", "10", "10", "10"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend to avoid prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone, build, install, and clean up in a single layer
# This optimizes the image size by removing build-time dependencies and caches.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Ensure certificates are up to date for secure git clone
    update-ca-certificates && \
    # Create a temporary build directory
    mkdir -p /opt/build && \
    cd /opt/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the AMG repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git . && \
    # Build from the root of the repository to ensure all library dependencies are compiled first.
    # The 'amg' executable is generated in the 'test' subdirectory.
    make && \
    # Copy the compiled binary from its build location to a system path
    cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Ensure the binary is executable by all
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to reduce final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/build && \
    # Clean up apt cache and remove packages only needed for the build
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove git make build-essential gfortran libopenmpi-dev && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes
# These settings improve performance and stability in non-HPC network environments
RUN echo "btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism = none" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_mapping_policy = slot" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_oversubscribe = 1" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a default working directory
WORKDIR /

# Define the default command to run when the container starts
# This will execute the amg benchmark with a sample problem set
CMD ["mpirun", "amg", "-n", "10", "10", "10"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend to avoid prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone, build, install, and clean up in a single layer
# This optimizes the image size by removing build-time dependencies and caches.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Ensure certificates are up to date for secure git clone
    update-ca-certificates && \
    # Create a temporary build directory
    mkdir -p /opt/build && \
    cd /opt/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the AMG repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git . && \
    # Build from the root of the repository to ensure all library dependencies are compiled first.
    # The 'amg' executable is generated in the 'test' subdirectory.
    make && \
    # Copy the compiled binary from its build location to a system path
    cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Ensure the binary is executable
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to reduce final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/build && \
    # Clean up apt cache and remove packages only needed for the build
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove git make build-essential gfortran libopenmpi-dev && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes
# These settings improve performance and stability in non-HPC network environments
RUN echo "btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism = none" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_mapping_policy = slot" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_oversubscribe = 1" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a default working directory
WORKDIR /

# Define the default command to run when the container starts
# This will execute the amg benchmark with a sample problem set
CMD ["mpirun", "amg", "-n", "10", "10", "10"]

    echo "rmaps_base_oversubscribe = 1" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a default working directory
WORKDIR /

# Define the default command to run when the container starts
# This will execute the amg benchmark with a sample problem set
CMD ["mpirun", "amg", "-n", "10", "10", "10"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend to avoid prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone, build, install, and clean up in a single layer
# This optimizes the image size by removing build-time dependencies and caches.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Ensure certificates are up to date for secure git clone
    update-ca-certificates && \
    # Create a temporary build directory
    mkdir -p /opt/build && \
    cd /opt/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the AMG repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git . && \
    # Build from the root of the repository to ensure all library dependencies are compiled first.
    # The 'amg' executable is generated in the 'test' subdirectory.
    make && \
    # Copy the compiled binary from its build location to a system path
    cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Ensure the binary is executable
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to reduce final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/build && \
    # Clean up apt cache and remove packages only needed for the build
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove git make build-essential gfortran libopenmpi-dev && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes
# These settings improve performance and stability in non-HPC network environments
RUN echo "btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism = none" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_mapping_policy = slot" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_oversubscribe = 1" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a default working directory
WORKDIR /

# Define the default command to run when the container starts
# This will execute the amg benchmark with a sample problem set
CMD ["mpirun", "amg", "-n", "10", "10", "10"]

Assets for minicluster Agent
flux-minicluster-manifest
# Corrective action for ImagePullBackOff error.
# The previous attempt failed due to a CPU architecture mismatch between the node (ARM)
# and the requested Flux container image (x86_64).
# This manifest corrects the issue by selecting an ARM-based node and specifying the
# corresponding ARM-compatible Flux container image.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Tasks are set to 64 to match the vCPU count of the m7g.16xlarge instance, preventing oversubscription.
  tasks: 64

  # Defines the application container to be run by Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The launcher container is managed by the Flux operator.
      launcher: false
      # Updated command with a larger problem size suitable for the selected instance.
      # The processor grid (-P 4 4 4) multiplies to 64, matching the total tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 128 128 -P 4 4 4
      # Environment variables to optimize for threading and MPI performance.
      environment:
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod specification to control scheduling.
  pod:
    # Selects a specific AWS ARM instance type for the job, ensuring correct architecture.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Flux-specific configurations for the ARM architecture.
  flux:
    arch: "arm"
    # Specifies the correct ARM-compatible container image for the Flux sidecar.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true
    # Reduces log verbosity for a cleaner output.
    quiet: true

  # Set cleanup to true to remove pods after the job completes, as per the corrective action.
  cleanup: true

# Fix: The primary error is ImagePullBackOff because the default flux container
# does not have a manifest for the ARM architecture of the node it was scheduled on.
# Resolution:
# 1. Explicitly select a powerful ARM instance (m7g.16xlarge) via the pod nodeSelector.
# 2. Set the flux architecture to 'arm'.
# 3. Specify the correct ARM-compatible flux container image ('arm-9' tag).
# 4. Set tasks equal to the number of CPUs on the selected instance (64) to avoid oversubscription.
# 5. Add environment variables to control threading for optimal performance.
# 6. Corrected the manifest structure by moving nodeSelector under 'spec.pod' from the invalid 'spec.job'.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Tasks are set to the vCPU count of the m7g.16xlarge instance.
  tasks: 64

  # Defines the application container to be run by Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This command is a good starting point for optimization on a 64-core machine.
      # The processor grid (4*4*4) matches the number of tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 4 4 4
      launcher: false
      # Environment variables to optimize threading for the application.
      environment:
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod specification to control scheduling.
  pod:
    # This ensures the job runs on the correct ARM instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Flux settings are adjusted for the selected ARM architecture.
  flux:
    arch: "arm"
    # This is the correct image for ARM nodes, fixing the ImagePullBackOff error.
    container:
      image: "ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9"

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    quiet: true
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true

  # Prevents the MiniCluster pods from being deleted after the job completes for debugging.
  cleanup: false

# Corrected manifest to resolve ImagePullBackOff error on ARM architecture.
# The previous job failed because it was scheduled on an ARM node without the required ARM-specific
# configuration for the Flux sidecar container, leading to an image architecture mismatch.
#
# Fixes applied:
# 1. Moved 'nodeSelector' from the invalid 'spec.job' field to the correct 'spec.pod' field.
# 2. Explicitly select the 'm7g.16xlarge' ARM instance type.
# 3. Set 'flux.arch' to 'arm' and 'flux.container.image' to the correct ARM-compatible tag.
# 4. Set 'tasks' to 64 to match the vCPU count of the instance, maximizing utilization without oversubscription.
# 5. Added 'strict: true' to logging, as required by the constraints.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Size is 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Tasks are set to the number of vCPU cores on the selected instance.
  tasks: 64

  # Defines the application container to be run by Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The main container does not run the launcher.
      launcher: false
      # Increased problem size and processor grid for the larger node.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 4 4 4
      # Environment variables for performance tuning and threading control.
      environment:
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod specification to control scheduling.
  pod:
    # Pin the job to a specific, powerful ARM instance type for optimization.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Flux settings are required for ARM (Graviton) instances.
  flux:
    arch: arm
    # This image tag is compatible with the ARM architecture of the selected node.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Reduce logging noise.
    quiet: true
    # Enforce strict schema validation.
    strict: true

  # Do not delete pods after completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

# Corrected and optimized MiniCluster manifest for amg2023.
# The previous attempt failed due to an ImagePullBackOff error on the Flux sidecar container,
# caused by an architecture mismatch. Additionally, the provided manifest had a structural error.
#
# Fixes Applied:
# 1. Corrected Manifest Structure: Moved the 'nodeSelector' from the invalid 'spec.job' field to the correct 'spec.pod' field.
# 2. Architecture-Specific Configuration: Explicitly set 'flux.arch' to 'arm' and corrected the 'flux.container.image'
#    to 'ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9' to match the ARM-based m7g.16xlarge instance.
# 3. Constraint Compliance: Added 'logging.strict: true' as required by the instructions.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The job size is 1 node with 64 tasks, matching the vCPU count of the selected instance.
  size: 1
  tasks: 64

  # Defines the application container to be run by Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      launcher: false
      # Optimized command with a processor grid matching the 64 tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 4 4 4
      # Environment variables for performance tuning as requested.
      environment:
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod specification to control scheduling. This ensures the MiniCluster is scheduled on the correct instance type.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Flux-specific settings for ARM architecture, critical to fix the ImagePullBackOff error.
  flux:
    arch: arm
    # Corrected the image to the required ':arm-9' for ARM instances.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Set quiet to true to reduce logging noise.
    quiet: true
    # Enforce strict schema validation.
    strict: true

  # Do not delete pods after completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

# Job failed due to ImagePullBackOff, indicating a CPU architecture mismatch.
# The default Flux image is for AMD64, but the pod was likely scheduled on an ARM node.
# FIX: Corrected manifest structure by moving nodeSelector to 'spec.pod' and backoffLimit to 'spec'.
# FIX: Explicitly select a high-performance ARM instance (m7g.16xlarge) and specify the
# corresponding ARM-compatible flux container image to ensure compatibility and resolve the error.
# FIX: Added 'logging.strict: true' to meet constraints.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Ensure we run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Match tasks to the vCPU count of the selected instance to utilize all cores.
  tasks: 64
  # Set backoffLimit to 1 to fail fast if the issue persists.
  backoffLimit: 1
  # Keep pods after completion for inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Defines the application container to be run by Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The main container does not launch flux; the operator handles it.
      launcher: false
      # Set command with a larger problem size. Processor grid (4*4*4) matches task count.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 4 4 4
      # Add environment variables for threading and MPI performance tuning.
      environment:
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod specification to control scheduling.
  pod:
    # Pin the job to a specific ARM instance type to guarantee architecture compatibility.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Specify ARM architecture and the correct flux image for ARM nodes.
  flux:
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Reduce logging noise for optimization runs.
    quiet: true
    # Enforce strict schema validation as required.
    strict: true

# Corrected MiniCluster Manifest to address runtime failure.
#
# Error Analysis:
# The Job failed with "BackoffLimitExceeded," indicating the application pod failed at runtime.
# The core issue is likely an instability in the AMG application with the previous MPI process topology.
#
# Proposed Fix:
# 1. Add `restartPolicy: Never` to the pod spec. This is critical for preserving failed pods
#    for debugging, ensuring they are not restarted by Kubernetes before logs can be inspected.
# 2. Change the AMG processor decomposition from a 3D grid (-P 4 4 4) to a 2D grid
#    (-P 8 8 1). This keeps the total task count at 64 but alters the process topology,
#    which may resolve the runtime instability.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Match tasks to the vCPU count of the m7g.16xlarge instance.
  tasks: 64
  # Fail fast if the pod fails, as the restart policy is handled at the pod level.
  backoffLimit: 1
  # Keep pods after the job finishes for inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Application container configuration.
  containers:
  - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
    # Modified command with a 2D process grid which may be more stable.
    command: amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 8 8 1
    launcher: false
    # Environment variables for performance tuning.
    environment:
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
      OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Ensure the pod is scheduled on the correct ARM-based instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge
    # Prevent Kubernetes from restarting the pod on failure, preserving it for debugging.
    restartPolicy: Never

  # Flux-specific settings for the ARM architecture.
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings.
  logging:
    quiet: true
    strict: true

# Corrected manifest to fix syntax and structural errors.
# The previous attempt failed due to invalid keys in 'environment' and 'nodeSelector' (extra quotes),
# and incorrect placement of pod-level specifications.
#
# Fixes Applied:
# 1. Corrected Syntax: Removed extraneous quotes from the environment variable and nodeSelector keys.
# 2. Corrected Structure: Moved 'nodeSelector' and 'restartPolicy' to the correct location under 'spec.pod'.
# 3. Corrected 'backoffLimit': Moved 'backoffLimit' to the top level of the 'spec' as required by the MiniCluster schema.
# 4. Maintained Optimization Parameters: Kept the ARM-specific instance, Flux image, and application command from the previous attempt.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The size of the MiniCluster (number of pods) must be 1.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks, matching the vCPUs of the m7g.16xlarge instance.
  tasks: 64
  # Set backoffLimit to 1 to fail fast if the pod encounters an error.
  backoffLimit: 1
  # Do not automatically clean up the job upon completion.
  cleanup: false

  # Application container definition.
  containers:
  - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
    launcher: false
    command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 64 64 -P 8 4 2
    # Corrected syntax for environment variables.
    environment:
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
      OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma

  # Pod-level specifications for scheduling and restart behavior.
  pod:
    # Set restartPolicy to Never to inspect logs of failed pods.
    restartPolicy: Never
    # Corrected placement and syntax for nodeSelector.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the ARM architecture.
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings.
  logging:
    quiet: true
    strict: true

# Corrected MiniCluster Manifest for AMG2023 Optimization.
# The previous attempt failed due to an ImagePullBackOff error (architecture mismatch)
# and the proposed fix contained structural errors in the manifest.
#
# Fixes Applied:
# 1. Corrected Manifest Structure: Removed the invalid 'jobSpec' field. Moved 'backoffLimit'
#    to 'spec', and moved 'nodeSelector' and 'restartPolicy' to the correct 'spec.pod' section
#    as required by the MiniCluster v1alpha2 schema.
# 2. Architecture-Specific Configuration: Retained the correct settings for the ARM architecture,
#    including the nodeSelector for m7g.1xlarge, flux.arch='arm', and the arm-9 flux container image.
# 3. Constraint Compliance: Added 'logging.strict: true' as required.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Tasks are set to 64 to match the vCPU count of the selected m7g.16xlarge instance.
  tasks: 64
  # Set backoffLimit to 1; if the job fails once, it will not be retried.
  backoffLimit: 1
  # Keep pods after job completion for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # The application container for the experiment.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      launcher: false
      # Optimized command with a larger problem size suitable for the instance.
      # The process grid (8*4*2=64) matches the total number of tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 64 64 -P 8 4 2
      # Environment variables set to optimize threading and MPI performance.
      environment:
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod-level specifications for scheduling and restarts.
  pod:
    # Add a nodeSelector to target a specific, powerful instance type for performance.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge
    # Set restartPolicy to Never to allow inspection of logs from failed pods.
    restartPolicy: Never

  # Flux settings are configured for the selected ARM64 architecture.
  flux:
    # Explicitly define the architecture as arm.
    arch: "arm"
    # Use the correct, architecture-specific image for the Flux framework sidecar.
    # This resolves the original ImagePullBackOff error.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Quiet logging is enabled to reduce noise.
    quiet: true
    # Enforce strict schema validation as required.
    strict: true

# Corrected and optimized MiniCluster manifest to resolve ImagePullBackOff error.
# The previous attempt failed because the manifest used an invalid field 'spec.job'
# for pod specifications, which is not part of the MiniCluster schema.
#
# Fixes Applied:
# 1. Corrected Manifest Structure: The 'nodeSelector' is moved from the invalid 'job'
#    section to the correct location under 'spec.pod'.
# 2. Architecture-Specific Configuration: The correct ARM architecture settings, including
#    the nodeSelector, flux.arch, and flux.container.image, are retained to fix the
#    original image pull error.
# 3. Constraint Compliance: Added 'logging.strict: true' as required by the instructions.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Set size to 1 node, and tasks to 64 to fully utilize the selected 64-core instance.
  size: 1
  tasks: 64

  # Defines the application container to be run by Flux.
  containers:
  - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
    # This application container is multi-arch and does not need to be changed.
    launcher: false
    # Optimized command to increase the problem size and utilize all 64 tasks.
    command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 64 64 -P 8 4 2
    # Add environment variables for performance tuning as per instructions.
    environment:
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod specification for scheduling and other pod-level attributes.
  pod:
    # Add nodeSelector to target a specific ARM instance type.
    # This ensures the pod lands on a node with the correct architecture.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Configure Flux for the ARM architecture to resolve the ImagePullBackOff error.
  flux:
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Use quiet logging as recommended for optimization runs.
    quiet: true
    # Enforce strict schema validation as required.
    strict: true

  # Ensure the job does not clean up on completion for inspection.
  cleanup: false

# Corrected and optimized MiniCluster manifest to resolve ImagePullBackOff error.
# The previous attempt failed because the manifest used an invalid 'spec.job' field,
# which is not part of the MiniCluster v1alpha2 schema.
#
# Fixes Applied:
# 1. Corrected Manifest Structure: The 'nodeSelector' has been moved from the invalid 'job'
#    section to the correct location under 'spec.pod'.
# 2. Architecture-Specific Configuration: The correct settings for the ARM architecture,
#    including the nodeSelector for m7g.16xlarge, flux.arch='arm', and the correct
#    'arm-9' flux container image, are retained to fix the image pull error.
# 3. Constraint Compliance: Added 'logging.strict: true' as required by the instructions.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-test-run
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is 1, as required, to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Tasks are set to 64 to match the vCPU count of the selected m7g.16xlarge instance, preventing oversubscription.
  tasks: 64

  # The application container specification.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      launcher: false
      # The command is updated with a larger problem size and processor grid for optimization.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 64 64 -P 8 4 2
      # Environment variables are set to control threading for optimal performance.
      environment:
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"

  # Pod-level specifications for scheduling.
  pod:
    # A nodeSelector ensures the job runs on a specific instance type, resolving
    # the image architecture mismatch by targeting a known ARM platform.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Flux-specific settings are configured here.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture of the target node. m7g.16xlarge is ARM.
    arch: arm
    # Provide the correct flux-view image for the ARM architecture to fix the ErrImagePull.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Logging is set to quiet to reduce noise, as per optimization instructions.
    quiet: true
    # Enforce strict schema validation as required.
    strict: true
  
  # Prevents pod cleanup on completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false
